heaven: existing: *mavopagoasa (Heaven); also ganreasa (paradise), cilniasa (the heavenly city)*
quest token: *kendejomrupelicono* (kendejomru+pelicono: quest-token: a game coin earned on a quest (nested compound, 2.0:G42)); *kendejomrucono* (kendejomru+cono: quest-coin: a shorter, more singable form)
reality: *pagomodo* (pago+modo: the manner of the world: how things really are)
materialized: *lumipusa* (lumi+pusa: light-dust: light turned into matter. 'It materialized' = ito po loya lumipusasan (adjective by 3.3:G148; no verb form exists))
adventure guide: *harlujomrupilo* (harlujomru+pilo: adventure-father: the one who guides an adventure (pilopa = to guide)); *harlujomrunela* (harlujomru+nela: adventure-person: a neutral alternative without the paternal tone)
abilities: *mavojuba* (mavo+juba: mind-gift: a talent or power; plural mavojubari); *manlijuba* (manli+juba: hand-gift: a practical skill)
soul: existing: *lulfaasa (the soul in flight; the psyche); mavolumi, the component of mavolumitali, also serves*
hugged: existing: *sumalomo (warm embrace, attested image compound); verb sumalomosia by 2.5:G124 (predicted form, flag it): po sumalomosia*
cute: *linuvani* (linu+vani: child-beauty: cuteness; linuvanisan = cute (3.3:G148)); or the existing *linusan (childlike) is close; the -ti diminutive carries affection*
nurture center: *marecemnu* (mare+cemnu: mother-centre: a centre of nurturing care); or the existing *kersopago (nursery; a place where young things grow), if it means a place for children*
data: existing: *serna (the root of sernaramu, sernasilro, sernasimvo)*
reflections: existing: *ramulumi (remembered light; a light that reveals memory), for reflections meaning thoughts looking back*
interactive: *manliseno* (manli+seno: hand-speech: something that answers touch; manlisenosan = interactive (3.3:G148))
shoulderhoods: *lulfavelma* (lulfa+velma: butterfly-garment: a hood that folds over the shoulders like wings)
activated: *navufarulumra* (navufaru+lumra: a lifting by lightning: switching something on; navufarulumrasan = activated (3.3:G148))
irl: *pagomodo* (pago+modo: reuses the coinage for 'reality': en pagomodo = in real life)
tablet: *sernafavro* (serna+favro: data signal-device: a tablet computer (favro is an archetype head, 3.2:G142)); or the existing *helnati (pill; tablet), for medicine*
reluctantly: *harlulore* (harlu+lore: a fearful, hesitant heart; la harluloresan = reluctantly (3.3:G148))
surreal: *zayumodo* (zayu+modo: a magic manner of being; zayumodosan = surreal); or the existing *zayusan (magical) is close*
saved: existing: *hirnaasasan (delivered; saved) for rescue; conohelvica (to save money) for money*
wonderful: existing: *ruli vanisan or ruli benasan (ruli + adjective, as in the 'excellent' recipe)*
horror section: *folluzupa* (follu+zupa: horror-room: the horror section (zupa is an archetype head, 3.2:G146))
rulebreakers: existing: *mavopagona (outlaw), plural mavopagonari; or li mavopagonasanri*
simultaneously: existing: *nayo ola (1.0:G17), or a nayo clause*
digital: *sernanulu* (serna+nulu: data-path; sernanulusan = digital (serna is a root with no listed -san form, so the adjective comes from the compound by 3.3:G148))
intimacy: *loresilro* (lore+silro: heart-secret: what only intimates share); or the existing *silrolore (secret heart, attested image compound) is close*
blessing: existing: *jubaseno (a blessing spoken aloud); devisavali for a divine blessing*
cubby: *helvikova* (helvi+kova: hiding-container: a small nook for keeping things (kova is an archetype head, 3.2:G146))
sarcasm: *loteroseno* (lotero+seno: other-speech: saying the opposite of what one means); or the existing *zoke (the irony particle), for the tone of a line*
perfect: existing: *lordiasasan (perfectly ordered); ruli benasan in everyday speech*
nurse: existing: *molusasvayo (caregiver); the verb is marema (to nurture)*
downstairs: existing: *en li kezuzupa (recipe, awaiting author review)*
